sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities. sources.snippet: Nepali Tokenizer Infrastructure Most LLM tokenizers need 2x-6x more tokens for Nepali than English. This repo measures that gap across 17 models, trains a Nepali-optimized tokenizer, and extends existing model tokenizers to close the gap.
